description: Found 2026-11-15 (bitstring split experiments). On fz-nml.11 31823421d both are 'lower/unbound: unresolved direct runtime callee'. fz-rs7.7 recorded them as absent and out of its scope. Elixir: bit_size/1 takes a bitstring and returns its bit count (guard-safe); binary_part/3 takes a binary, start and length (negative length counts back), raises ArgumentError out of range, guard-safe. bit_size's domain is bitstring, so this lands after fz-sc8.30 (the bitstring/binary split). binary_part of a large binary should return a view (fz-nml.1), not a copy. Acceptance: oracle fixture covering bodies and guards, partial bitstrings for bit_size, the negative-length and out-of-range cases for binary_part, three paths.
title: Kernel has bit_size/1 and binary_part/3, in bodies and guards, as in Elixir
